backup.encryptionMissingDesc: Backups contain password hashes and API keys, so they cannot be created without an encryption key. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32` and register it as BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY in the secrets settings. If this key is lost, existing backups can no longer be restored.
backup.mergeDesc: Imports this backup's contents without deleting current data. Deleted records will not be resurrected.
backup.mergeReviewNote: Differences in tables that are unsafe to merge automatically (users, credentials). These are not changed by this run.
backup.restoreModeAllDesc: Deletes all existing data and replaces it entirely with the state at the time of the backup.
backup.restoreModeDownloadsDesc: Deletes nothing. Only restores project and version download counts that were inflated by DDoS or similar.
backup.restoreModeTablesDesc: Clears only the selected tables and restores them from the backup.

runtime.title: Service controls
runtime.description: Switch the site-wide operating mode and stop individual features here. A smaller blast radius means faster recovery.

featureHelp.upload: Stops new version uploads. Existing files stay downloadable.
featureHelp.jarAnalysis: Stops only the JAR analysis on upload. Uploads still work and analysis can be re-run later.
featureHelp.download: Stops downloads served through ModParks. External distribution links remain.
featureHelp.comment: Stops new comments. Existing comments stay visible.

runtime.reasonHelp: Record why it is being disabled. This is what tells you later whether it is safe to re-enable.
runtime.modeHelp: Changes site-wide behaviour. Prefer feature switches when they suffice — a smaller blast radius means faster recovery.

modeDesc.NORMAL: Everything runs according to the feature switches.
modeDesc.STATIC: Stops posting, uploads and downloads, and directs visitors to the static archive. Read APIs redirect to static JSON. The admin UI stays usable.
modeDesc.MAINTENANCE: Stops everything except the admin UI. Does not recover automatically.

runtime.durationHelp: Returns to normal automatically when the deadline passes, so a forgotten switch does not keep the site down. Maintenance does not auto-recover.
runtime.snapshotHelp: Generates the read-only archive data now. It is normally produced right after the daily backup; use this to check the contents before switching modes.

trust.description: Per-user trust values used as a moderation aid. Values are visible here only and are never shown to the user.
trust.disclaimer: Trust values are advisory. Base bans and removals on the individual events, not on this number.

detail.title: Trust credit detail

detail.frozenNotice: Frozen: automatic credits are paused. Penalties still apply.
detail.ledgerHint: "Raw" is the value at record time; "current" is its effect today after decay.

bulkAdjust.title: Bulk Adjust Score for Selected Users
bulkAdjust.hint: Add manual events to the ledgers of all checked users.

override.title: Override tier
override.hint: Pins the tier independently of the score. Overusing this makes trust values meaningless.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.content:
These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of ModParks ("the Service"). By accessing or using the Service, you agree to be bound by these Terms.

## 1. Account Management
You are responsible for safeguarding the password that you use to access the Service and for any activities or actions under your password.

## 2. Prohibited Conduct
You agree not to engage in any of the following prohibited activities:
- Violating any laws or regulations.
- Infringing upon the rights of others.
- Uploading or distributing malware, spam, or malicious content.
- Uploading or posting content that is entirely unrelated to the purpose of this Service (sharing Minecraft-related content).

## 3. Modification of Terms
We reserve the right to modify or replace these Terms at any time without prior notice.

## 4. Use of Google Analytics
We use Google Analytics to analyze and improve our services. Google Analytics uses cookies to collect data. This data is collected anonymously and does not identify individual users. If you wish to opt-out of Google Analytics tracking, you can use browser opt-out add-ons.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
ModParks ("we", "our", or "us") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information.

## 1. Information Collection
We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, which includes your email address and username.

## 2. Use of Information
The information we collect is used to provide, maintain, and improve the Service, as well as to communicate with you.

## 3. Data Sharing
We do not share your personal information with third parties except as necessary to provide our services or as required by law.

## 4. Security
We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access.

## 5. Cookie and Analytics Tools
We use Google Analytics to understand how users interact with the Service. Google Analytics may set cookies on your browser or read existing cookies to collect information. Your web browser automatically sends certain non-personal information (such as the web address of the page you're visiting and your IP address) to Google. This information is used solely to analyze site traffic and generate reports for the site administrator.

## 6. Information Obtained Through Google Account Sign-in
We offer sign-in and account linking through your Google account (Google API Services). Only when you sign in with Google or link your Google account, we receive the following information from Google:
- Your email address
- Your name or display name
- The URL of your profile picture
- Your Google account identifier

We use this information solely for the following purposes:
- Creating your account and verifying your identity when you sign in
- Setting up and displaying your profile on this site (display name and avatar)
- Contacting you when necessary to operate the Service

Authentication tokens are stored in our database only to the extent necessary for the purposes above. Our use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy ( https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy ), including the Limited Use requirements. We do not use this information for advertising, sell it to third parties, or allow humans to read it, except with your explicit consent, as necessary for security investigations, to comply with applicable law, or where the information has been aggregated and anonymized.

You can disconnect your Google account at any time from the Integrations section of your settings. Once disconnected, the Google account identifier and tokens stored on this site are deleted.

## 7. Information Obtained Through GitHub Account Sign-in
We offer sign-in and account linking through your GitHub account. Only when you sign in with GitHub or link your GitHub account, we receive the following information from GitHub:
- Your email address
- Your username and display name
- The URL of your profile picture
- Your GitHub account identifier

We use this information solely for the following purposes:
- Creating your account and verifying your identity when you sign in
- Setting up and displaying your profile on this site (display name and avatar)
- Displaying a link to your GitHub account on your profile page

Once linked, your GitHub username is shown publicly on your profile page by default. You can hide it from the Integrations section of your settings.

You can disconnect your GitHub account at any time from the Integrations section of your settings. Once disconnected, the GitHub account identifier and tokens stored on this site are deleted.
